patterns.note: The entire page is structured as a single, continuous, deep vertical scroll through distinct, highly detailed illustrative scenes, rather than segmented content blocks.
Hand-drawn, illustrative display typography is used for key brand elements and section titles, contrasted with clean, bold sans-serifs for headings and body text.
A maximalist, vibrant, and diverse color palette is used to define distinct illustrative sections and create high visual energy, with strong contrasts between elements.
The hero section employs a multi-layer parallax effect, where foreground illustrative elements scroll faster than background elements, creating a sense of depth as the user begins to scroll.

Each major content section is presented as a unique, full-width, highly detailed illustration that visually tells a story or represents a concept, rather than using traditional content blocks or cards.

technique_notes: The page is built upon a very tall, continuous illustrative background canvas, with all text, interactive elements, and video embeds positioned as distinct layers on top of this rich visual foundation.

The hero section utilizes a multi-layered parallax scrolling effect, where different illustrative background elements move at varying speeds relative to the scroll position, creating a deep, immersive opening experience.
Content sections are visually delineated by entirely different, full-bleed illustrative scenes that scroll into view, maintaining a consistent hand-drawn aesthetic throughout the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are very large and bold, often uppercase, contrasting significantly with smaller, clean sans-serif body text, creating a playful yet authoritative hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are prevalent for most interactive elements and text containers, but the overall illustrative style incorporates many organic, soft curves and irregular shapes.
design_tokens.spacing: Very dense and packed with intricate illustrations and details, with minimal traditional whitespace; visual breathing room is created by the open areas within the illustrations themselves.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its maximalist, continuous, hand-drawn illustrative canvas that serves as the primary structure and content delivery mechanism. It feels less like a website and more like an interactive graphic novel, using deep, detailed illustrations to tell the brand's story and define each section.
